description: This file defines functions and types related to managing and validating safe binary execution policies, including interpreting safe bin names, merging profiles, and resolving runtime policies for safe binaries.

methods.name: isInterpreterLikeSafeBin
methods.description: Checks if a given safe bin name matches known interpreter-like safe bin patterns or names.

methods.name: listInterpreterLikeSafeBins
methods.description: Filters and sorts a list of safe bin entries to include only interpreter-like safe bins.

methods.name: resolveMergedSafeBinProfileFixtures
methods.description: Merges global and local safe bin profile fixtures into a single record, normalizing profiles.

methods.name: resolveExecSafeBinRuntimePolicy
methods.description: Resolves and returns the runtime policy for safe binaries, including safe bins, profiles, trusted directories, and warnings.
